editorial:
Imagine trying to hide from your past in a quiet cabin in the woods, only to have a weird case drag you right back into the chaos. You get to follow a disgraced former cop who just wants to be left alone, but a private investigator shows up with a job he can't refuse. The plot kicks off when the wife of a famous and very strange TV star gets murdered, and the world of celebrity fame turns out to be way more dangerous than the police force. It has a cool, gritty vibe that feels like a modern noir story, mixing a dark mystery with a bit of a strange, quirky energy.

You will really enjoy the chemistry between the leads and how the mystery slowly unfolds. While the pacing starts a bit slow, the twists keep you guessing and the action hits hard when it finally arrives. It is not perfect, but it is a great way to spend a Friday night.
endingExplained: You find out that the TV star was not as innocent as he seemed. The investigation reveals a web of lies involving money and betrayal. In the final showdown, the truth about the murder comes out, and the bad guys get what they deserve in a violent clash. The ex-cop finally finds some closure and peace, realizing that he can't run from his skills, but he can choose who he helps.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves detective stories and dark secrets.
